a champagne diamond

items.name: a chocolate opal
items.description: The rich chocolate hue of the opal creates an intense play of color throughout the depths of the gem.

items.name: a clockwork electroweave engineer's toolbelt with copper mechanisms
items.tap: a clockwork electroweave engineer's toolbelt with copper mechanisms
items.description:
As if charged with electricity, the toolbelt gently coruscates in luminous shades of white, blue, and green that run along a network of jagged silvery streaks inherent in the weave.  Copper tools nest in dedicated loops, their gleaming surfaces offset by the silvery veins woven into the fabric.
It currently does not have any items tied to it.

items.name: a cushion-cut shadow emerald
items.description: Deep green in coloration, this emerald holds black inclusions at its heart with smoky tendrils swirling toward the edges.

items.name: a densely forged ka'hurst mail hauberk richly padded with electroweave
a dirty inkpot
a dye case
items.description: You must be holding the case first. | You must be holding the case first.

items.name: a fanciful quelium meteor hammer blossoming with a pair of unicorn lilies
items.tap: a fanciful quelium meteor hammer blossoming with a pair of unicorn lilies
items.description: Blooms cast out of starlight-white uthamar unfold from each end of the bright green metal chain, their delicate petals curled up to form the shape of a tiny horse's head.  Gracing the unicorn lilies with a silvery-green glow, delicate verdant moonsilver vines encircle each blossom and wrap around the weapon's chain.

items.name: a flooded goldfyre signet ring bearing the crest of a tidal bloodstone kraken
a forgeheart iron scimitar with a grimwood hilt
items.tap: a forgeheart iron scimitar with a grimwood hilt
items.description: Plain to the point of austerity, the curved sweep of the blade is unadorned except for the reddish-orange chakrel dust worked into the metal during the forging process that resembles a billowing cloud of windswept embers.  The midnight-black wood of the handle complements the gleaming blade of the excellently balanced weapon.

items.name: a fragile faesilk gem pouch dangling sungold key charms
a frostflare opal
items.description: Tiny multihued snowflake-shaped crystals hang suspended in the heart of the frostflare opal.

items.name: a heavily scarred warrior's belt fit with a blackened silver buckle
a heavy animite shackle engraved with intricate knotwork
items.tap: a heavy animite shackle engraved with intricate knotwork
items.description: The delicate pattern travels around the shackle's circumference, forming a chain of neverending knots.  The dark silvery-grey metal itself is sturdy, and though at one time it was used to capture unruly criminals it now serves a far more practical use as a defensive tool to stave off blows.

items.name: a honeydew diamond
items.description: The pale green stone is faceted to best display its white edges.

items.name: a jadeleaf sigil booklet with pounded vilt reed pages
items.tap: a jadeleaf sigil booklet with pounded vilt reed pages

items.name: a large glacier emerald
items.description: You see nothing unusual.

items.tap: a lifesculpted lirisan wristcuff of overlapping leaves

items.tap: a lustrous seasilk weapon harness trimmed with a row of shark teeth
items.description: Dyed a rich cobalt hue, the silky fabric is stretched over a base of thick leather to create a sturdy container capable of holding an assortment of weapons.  Serrated teeth line the opening at the top of the harness, the tips blunted to prevent any accidents when retrieving contents from within.

items.name: a mammoth tusk warhorn engraved with a volley of arrows
a merlot ruby

Outlined with dark crimson borders, wide lengths of blue-white leather crisscross the gloves in a simple diamond pattern.
The barest hint of a blue-white shimmer appears across the surface of the leather.

items.name: some muracite tongs with icesteel clamps
items.tap: some muracite tongs with icesteel clamps
items.description: Graceful handles of dark grey bear midnight blue calfskin grips studded with platinum stars.  The frost-blue clamps are etched with a faint pattern of stylized moons.

items.tap: a collared white linen shirt patterned with palm leaves

items.tap: a cream-colored steelsilk gown with a forest-green overskirt

Delicate silk embroidery depicting ivy vines and leaves runs along the edges of the skirts with the underskirt done in deep green and the overskirt in creamy white.  The garment is cut to allow freedom of movement while still retaining enough style to grace all but the most formal occasion.

items.tap: a front-laced bodice of crimson silk adorned with gold star charms

items.name: a lilac mirror
items.description:
Gazing into the mirror, you see yourself, but with an altered appearance:
You have a soft-featured face with a youthful complexion, some dark glitter dotted with scarlet bee balm winging away from evasive emerald eyes, a tiny star-shaped night diamond nose stud piercing a freckled nose and dimples.  Your lilac hair is shoulder length and wavy, and is worn arranged in pigtails.  You have fair skin with an ethereal radiance and a gracefully slender figure.
You are average height for a Human.
An itsy-bitsy pixie brandishing a vial of violaceous glitter floats lazily around your left arm, glowing with a lustrous sheen against your skin.
You are in your prime.
You have a soft pink bunny nose attached to your nose.  Tiny black whiskers protrude outward, wiggling with your every movement.
You have a tattoo of a double helix symbol of evolution on your wrist.

items.tap: a long white silk skirt embroidered with a row of morning glories along its hem

items.name: a sungold sunburst with fiery rays of crimson glaes

Subtly inlaid in yellow gold -- and therefore only discernible by carefully scrutinizing how light plays across the piece -- is a circle bounded by a square, bounded by an equilateral triangle, all of which are bounded by another circle.  A matching chain tethers the sunburst to the belt.

items.name: a Dwarven greataxe with an intricately-engraved tyrium double-bladed head
items.tap: a Dwarven greataxe with an intricately-engraved tyrium double-bladed head
items.description: This greataxe has a hefty double-bladed design.  On one side of the head, the a deep purple metal has an extensive engraving of a lone Dwarf standing at the forefront of a battle, wielding a similar axe in her hands.  Opposing it, the other face contains an inset depicting that same Dwarf offering a handful of coins to a room full of others.  Embedded in the head are blue svelae gems, their colorful pockets cut into coin-shaped facets, and a name is carved into each side of the head. | "Taratochs the Skullcleaver"

items.name: a black-purple gloamstone sphere
items.description: The dense, fine-grained mineral bears a lustrous surface that shifts between dusky and wine-toned hues, its polished planes catching faint glimmers beneath the uneven marbling.  Threadlike veins of shadowed pigment wind through the stone in irregular arcs, softening the transitions between shades.

items.name: a curved kythe with a sinuous black hilt inlaid with iahja crystal naga scales
items.tap: a curved kythe with a sinuous black hilt inlaid with iahja crystal naga scales
items.description: Folded out of translucent layers of glaes, the dark blade displays a pattern of blue-black waves down its length.  The blackwood hilt is intricately carved into the shape of a naga poised to strike with its cobra-like hood flared open.  Tiny vivid green crystal shards shimmering with bright blue and yellow opalescence serve as the creature's eyes.

items.name: a damite tactical knife with a smokewood hilt
items.tap: a damite tactical knife with a smokewood hilt
items.description: The dark blade's matte finish helps to absorb light so as not to betray the user's position.  Like wisps of smoke trapped under glass, the dark wood has a rich and delicate grain.  A leather cord allows the tool to be secured to one's belt.

items.name: a heavy cloak of layered animal furs with a gnarled grimwood clasp
items.tap: a heavy cloak of layered animal furs with a gnarled grimwood clasp
items.description: Several layers of mismatched animal furs make up the bulk of the garment.  A gnarled and knotted piece of midnight-black wood dappled with pale grey rosettes serves as a clasp to secure the garment to the wearer.

items.name: a long stemmed ironrot pipe with a tursa band
items.tap: a long stemmed ironrot pipe with a tursa band
items.description: Sleek black wood that glistens like an oil slick with irregular blotches of dark green and purple marring the surface forms a generous bowl, attached to a long black stem that's joined to the wood with a small ring of dark translucent metal with opaque whorls.

items.name: a perfectly smooth sphere of crimson moonsilver
a silversteel ritual knife inscribed with an intricate pattern of palm leaves
items.tap: a silversteel ritual knife inscribed with an intricate pattern of palm leaves
items.description: The bright reflective blade of this knife is inscribed with recessed images of overlapping leaves of a palm tree.  A thick cord wraps around its hilt.

items.name: a small demonscale shield pyrographed with a map of the Blasted Plains
items.tap: a small demonscale shield pyrographed with a map of the Blasted Plains
items.description: Barely visible over the midnight-blue leather is a tropical paradise superimposed over a hellish volcanic landscape.  The golden metal boss is etched with an eye whose lid is sewn shut.

items.name: a smokewood-hafted ranseur with a haralun tip and cross-hilt
a sturdy belt dangling thirty-nine cambrinth disks
a stylish shadesatin waistcoat fastened by smooth whiskey quartz
items.tap: a stylish shadesatin waistcoat fastened by smooth whiskey quartz
items.description: The garment's wide lapels are meticulously starched and come together low on the body, drawing the eye to the coppery bourbon-hued buttons.

items.name: a sweeping loimic glaive with a blade fashioned to resemble a comet
a tailored plumette damask waistcoat buttoned with a trio of passionfruit beryls
items.tap: a tailored plumette damask waistcoat buttoned with a trio of passionfruit beryls
items.description: Exquisitely cut to resemble their namesake fruit, the translucent purple gems display a vivid yellow center and black dots that resemble seeds.  The stones glimmer beautifully against the alternating satin and matte patterns worked into the silky fabric, which creates a breathtaking illusion of a peacock's tail plumage.

items.name: some exquisitely tailored stoneskin tweed trousers
some lightweight void-black gauntlets chased in quelium flames
a bearclaw emerald
items.description: The stone is a vibrant lime color with a gleaming silver inclusion that resembles a majestic bear claw at its core.

items.name: a mistwood gem display case with gold leaf accents
a sturdy iron-studded black leather spellbook case
items.tap: a sturdy iron-studded black leather spellbook case
items.description: The case is open to the compartment that holds a spellbook.

items.name: a viperscale alexandrite
items.description: The blue-green stone is exceptionally clear.  Threads of red-gold streak through the gem in a scale-like pattern.

items.name: a Drogor's Wrath sapphire
a brass-inlaid mace with an ironwood haft
items.tap: a brass-inlaid mace with an ironwood haft
items.description: A spiraling pattern of thin brass lines runs around the thick haft of this steel-headed weapon.  The grey and brown bands of the wood contrast with the dull red of the inlay.

items.name: a classic Yavash-red smoking jacket with black satin lapels
items.tap: a classic Yavash-red smoking jacket with black satin lapels
items.description: Synonymous with comfort and elegance, this mid-thigh length jacket is designed to absorb smoke and protect the wearer from falling ash.  A bold paisley pattern embroidered over the fine moonspun silk complements the garment's sleek black cuffs and lapels.

items.name: a copper-inlaid mace with an ironwood haft
items.tap: a copper-inlaid mace with an ironwood haft
items.description: A spiraling pattern of thin copper lines runs around the thick haft of this steel-headed weapon.  The grey and brown bands of the wood contrast with the dull red of the inlay.

items.name: a cracked granite heavy mallet with a wire-bound black ironwood handle
items.tap: a cracked granite heavy mallet with a wire-bound black ironwood handle
items.description: Approaching the epitome of function over form, the stalwart, blocky head of this oversized hammer shows evidence of extreme use while sacrificing none of its efficacy in the process.  Tightly coiled steel is spiral-bound about the portion of the haft meant for the hand during use, lending a superior grip over the smooth wood beneath.

items.name: a hooded cloak of rose-hued silk with a gold embroidered hem
items.tap: a hooded cloak of rose-hued silk with a gold embroidered hem
items.description: A serene landscape unfolds along the bottom hem, featuring a lone traveler gazing towards a rising sun embroidered in shimmering gold and orange threads.

items.name: a jagged sandstone shard with a lump of soulstone embedded in one end
items.tap: a jagged sandstone shard with a lump of soulstone embedded in one end
items.description: Smooth and slightly oblong, the soulstone is about the size of a woman's fist.  Its glossy surface swirls with patterns of black and white which resemble a churning thunderstorm.

items.name: a long gilt-edged dagger with a central blood channel
items.tap: a long gilt-edged dagger with a central blood channel
items.description: It looks like a long gilt-edged dagger with a central blood channel.

items.name: a rough leather war belt with a razaksel-crow's head belt buckle
items.tap: a rough leather war belt with a razaksel-crow's head belt buckle
items.description: Light brown metal forms a crow's head shaped buckle, with detailed feathers and striking black eyes.

items.name: a wispy whisperlayne uaro's'sugi trimmed with midnight onyx
items.tap: a wispy whisperlayne uaro's'sugi trimmed with midnight onyx
items.description: Subtle black embroidery, interspersed with layered  chips of black and white gems, sparkles arrestingly against the length of sheer fabric.

items.name: an insulated robe
items.tap: an insulated robe
items.description: You see the initials "M. C." impressed into the surface of the fabric.

items.name: a bright lime-green sarong embroidered with azure poison dart frogs
items.tap: a bright lime-green sarong embroidered with azure poison dart frogs
items.description: The colorful blue frogs starkly contrast the vibrant green hue of the shimmery uzil used to create this loose-fitting garment.

items.name: a large emerald gift box topped with a golden bow
items.tap: a large emerald gift box topped with a golden bow
items.description: You see nothing unusual.

items.tap: a lustrous fuchsia seasilk sarong fringed with white silk
items.description: The brightly-hued fabric is cut to hug the body comfortably and allow freedom of movement, its vivid pink hue contrasting the pristine white threads embellishing its hemline.

items.tap: a smokey glass globe suspended within a delicate lumium cage
items.description: As you move your globe, you see a horde of mindless automaton swirling in an ever-shifting pattern about an abandoned artificer's workshop.

items.name: a blue gold torque with Idon's sapphire finials
items.tap: a blue gold torque with Idon's sapphire finials
items.description: Each arm of the deep blue metal ends in a highly polished sphere of Idon's sapphire, which is flecked with gold inclusions that match the gold marbling of the thick metal torque.

items.name: a blue-white mistglass brooch inset with a volcano's heart citrine
a blue-white mistglass ring with an inlaid alshabi stone cabochon

items.tap: a cloth-of-silver storage book clasped with an abyssal quartz button
items.description: When hit by light, the dusky blue stone almost appears to be marred with wet, diseased-looking spots. | You should be holding the storage book first.

items.name: a cracked asini book of "The Great Pack" heavily worn at the edges
items.tap: a cracked asini book of "The Great Pack" heavily worn at the edges
items.description: Deep fissures snake across the blood-red cover of the book, heavily disfiguring the embossing of the title.  The edges are worn down, particularly on the long side, lending a bit of curvature to their lines.  A matching chain affixed to the spine allows the book to be worn.

items.name: a crossbody bag of charcoal oilskin fastened by a carved nacre-bone wing
items.tap: a crossbody bag of charcoal oilskin fastened by a carved nacre-bone wing
items.description: The utilitarian construction of this simple container is contrasted by a single piece of avian-shaped bone.  Pearlescent lines crisscross the surface of the bone like white light dancing upon the surface of rolling ocean waves.

items.name: a dainty cowbell fit with a polished zulnatha handle
a dark cat-ear headband fashioned from penta-hued gloomglass
items.tap: a dark cat-ear headband fashioned from penta-hued gloomglass
items.description: The gently curved length of thin metal is generously wrapped in velvet to be comfortable when worn, and provide sturdy support for a pair of dusky feline ears.  Beneath its polished surface, shifting prismatic tones drift and merge, their movement contained within the translucent depths.

items.name: a dark sapphire icesilk sochi clasped by a carved moss agate
items.tap: a dark sapphire icesilk sochi clasped by a carved moss agate
items.description: The draping rectangle of flowing silk is cut to fall in a straight line to the mid-calf when worn, and its silvery-white warp threads glitter icily against the sapphire metallic threads used in the weft of the textile.  A short over-cape sloppily stitched with dark grey silk filigree can be drawn up into a cowled hood when desired. | An inconspicuous tag reads, "Limited Tre" but is smudged and indecipherable beyond that.

items.name: a diamond and platinum necklace with suspended stormfire topaz globular pendants
items.tap: a diamond and platinum necklace with suspended stormfire topaz globular pendants
items.description: Beads encrusted with small diamonds run along the necklace, each one between a larger stormfire topaz bead.  The highly polished orbs are greyish-blue and hold within their depths small occlusions resembling lightning bolts.

items.name: a dragonfly-shaped loimic pin with blue mistglass wings
items.tap: a dragonfly-shaped loimic pin with blue mistglass wings
items.description: Inlaid into the long body of the insect are tiny diamonds and sapphires, giving the effect of bands running down the thorax and abdomen.  The pale blue translucent wings are outlined in silvery-hued loimic wire and feature a small cabochon dendritic opal at the tip of each wing.

items.name: a dull tin sieve with cracked handles
items.tap: a dull tin sieve with cracked handles
items.description: Although the handles are somewhat worn and weathered, the tool is still servicable.

items.name: a fanciful rat puppet formed from rainbow-colored segments of ialalhe
items.tap: a fanciful rat puppet formed from rainbow-colored segments of ialalhe
items.description: Multiple small lengths of ialalhe are stitched together to form a rainbow-like progression of colors.  The material has a strong sheen as light plays across it and reflects off the tiny crushed gemstone fragments that have collected along each seam.

items.name: a fashionable sunfire faille cloak with intricate Elven gold clasps
items.tap: a fashionable sunfire faille cloak with intricate Elven gold clasps
items.description: Brilliant shades of golden yellow and flame-orange are subtly enhanced by the faint ribbing created by the fabric's weaving process.  Extravagant use of sunfire fibers causes the textile to appear to have a rippling mirage of sunlight running across the surface much like late afternoon sunbeams playing across a placid lake.  The illusion is further amplified by the occasional use of metallic golden filaments to highlight the fabric's ribbing.

items.name: a fragile faesilk gem pouch dangling sungold key charms
a glass perfume bottle fit with a sandalwood stopper
a glossy kuwinite signet ring etched with a bowl of raspberries
items.tap: a glossy kuwinite signet ring etched with a bowl of raspberries
items.description: The ring is etched with a bowl of plump raspberries.

items.name: a golden filigreed scepter capped with a star-shaped Dalaeji black sapphire
items.tap: a golden filigreed scepter capped with a star-shaped Dalaeji black sapphire
items.description: Gleaming gold filigree overlays the blackened steel haft with an intricate pattern of runic symbols displayed within a wrapping crosshatched pattern.  Capping the ornate weapon is an exquisite star-shaped Dalaeji black sapphire, providing an additional measure of destruction to the bulky scepter.

items.name: a green dragonar satchel with a large heliotrope clasp
items.tap: a green dragonar satchel with a large heliotrope clasp
items.description: Pale green vines with splashes of blue and purple have been stitched chaotically onto the soft material, giving it appearance similar to a flowering vine.  A long padded strap is affixed to the bag and secured by a flower-shaped clasp carved out of a pinkish gemstone with strong purple undertones.

items.name: a green punka cloak with black braid trimming
items.tap: a green punka cloak with black braid trimming
items.description: Although remarkably strong and resistant to wear and tear, the outer fabric retains a bumpy surface and a green tinge from its processing.  Rather than fight the resultant greenish coloration, the designers chose instead to dye the garment a deep green and trim it with plain black braid.  A grinning goblin's face forms the dark iron clasp.

items.name: a ka'hurst hide scraper etched with evergreen trees
items.tap: a ka'hurst hide scraper etched with evergreen trees
items.description: The shadowy black metal with a strikingly green sheen stands out against the leather handle's chocolate-brown hue.  A forest scene with multiple trees has been etched into each side of the blade.

items.name: a knee-length voidfrost brocade skirt with a narrow ruffle around the hem
items.tap: a knee-length voidfrost brocade skirt with a narrow ruffle around the hem
items.description: Cut to fall just below the wearer's knees, the richly figured fabric is gathered at the wide waistband.  Worked into the weave of this luxurious fabric is a subtle design of stars of varying shapes.  The subtle illusion of starlight glinting across the textile's surface emanating from the voidfrost fibers is enhanced by the deep sable hue of the background fibers.

items.name: a kuwinite wristlet with broad engraved links
items.tap: a kuwinite wristlet with broad engraved links
items.description: Each bright pink link is embellished with a wide triskelion.

items.name: a labyrinthine crown of tentacles framing a soulstone eye
items.tap: a labyrinthine crown of tentacles framing a soulstone eye
items.description: Writhing tentacles of green gold sprout from a lidless eye, coiling among themselves to form a semi-circular crown.  Perched atop the eye is a tiny shrike clutching an upturned crescent.

items.name: a lacquered rowan crossbow with a silversteel prod
items.tap: a lacquered rowan crossbow with a silversteel prod
items.description: The prod is polished to a high gloss.

items.name: a lush midnight-blue westan wool waistcoat edged with starfire velvet
items.tap: a lush midnight-blue westan wool waistcoat edged with starfire velvet
items.description: The slim-fitting garment features narrow lapels composed of soft velvet.  Minuscule ruby chips worked into the velvet create an illusion of falling stars shooting across a night sky.

items.name: a luxurious oxblood rosecloth waistcoat lined with gold paisley silk
items.tap: a luxurious oxblood rosecloth waistcoat lined with gold paisley silk
items.description: Intermixed throughout the burnished orange and fiery red curlicues woven across the surface of the fabric are tiny squirrels and hedgehogs.

items.name: a midnight-blue starlight velvet cloak with an embroidered hemline
items.tap: a midnight-blue starlight velvet cloak with an embroidered hemline
items.description: When the light hits the fabric just right, the minuscule diamond chips woven into the fabric glitter and cause an illusion resembling sparkling stars on a moonlit night.  Embroidered along the bottom hem is a continuous line of the three moons in alternating succession -- first large dark Katamba, then tiny blue Xibar, and lastly crimson Yavash.  All of the moons are shown in various stages of their waxing and waning cycles.

items.name: a mistsilk necktie with various faces swirling across its surface
items.tap: a mistsilk necktie with various faces swirling across its surface
items.description: Faces of every kind swirl chaotically across the translucent grey fabric.

items.name: a narrow gold bangle of two abutted ram's heads with a vengeance ruby between
items.tap: a narrow gold bangle of two abutted ram's heads with a vengeance ruby between
items.description: Nestled between the two facing heads is a faceted spherical vengeance ruby, its blood-red hue displaying glints of purple inclusions deep within the stone.  The two male sheep boast spiraling horns worked in low relief and showcase glittering black diamonds as their eyes.

items.name: a nomlas-hued faesilk cravat with black polka dots
items.tap: a nomlas-hued faesilk cravat with black polka dots
items.description: The orangy-pink scarf is designed to create a harmonious display of fashion and disarray.   The black polka dots speckled over the otherwise plain strip of fabric.

items.name: a pair of dagger-shaped cufflinks hilted with blood rubies
a pale pink lace-trimmed moneybelt
items.tap: a pale pink lace-trimmed moneybelt
items.description: Delicate white lace runs along both edges of the dyed Elven wool belt.

items.name: a pale spiritwood faenellica flecked by goldbark striations
items.tap: a pale spiritwood faenellica flecked by goldbark striations
items.description: Resembling the appearance of musical notes, golden wavy grooves mark the otherwise pristine white instrument.

items.name: a pink cone hat topped with a petunia
a polished scimitar with a leather-wrapped hilt bearing a circular cambrinth medallion
items.tap: a polished scimitar with a leather-wrapped hilt bearing a circular cambrinth medallion
items.description: The high sheen of the blade bears no decoration other than cinnabar-rubbed flames along its length.  Affixed to the hilt, the engraved round disc displays a wreath of vines encircling a crossed sword and lute.

items.name: a punka coat with sirenstone buttons
items.tap: a punka coat with sirenstone buttons
items.description: A soft and pliable waist-length coat with a greenish tinge has been dyed a deep blue color and is covered with countless tiny bumps.  Three buttons of polished azure-hued stones with paler blue striations are carved to resemble fish, fastening the garment snugly around the wearer when worn.

items.name: a radiate crown of icesteel and shattered soulstone
items.tap: a radiate crown of icesteel and shattered soulstone
items.description: Jagged spires of varying height jut outward from the head, their edges angled like broken spears frozen mid-burst.  Between the tallest spines, irregular shards of soulstone are embedded at sharp angles, each one dark and glossy, with pale veining like smoke trapped in ice.  The stones are set unevenly, some partially sunken, others protruding like splinters, lending the crown a chaotic and fractured silhouette.

items.name: a ragged shirt
items.description: You see nothing unusual.

items.name: a reinforced zenganne sack banded by thick leather belts
items.tap: a reinforced zenganne sack banded by thick leather belts
items.description: Dark metal rivets are evenly spaced along each of the three belts encircling the sack.  The zenganne beneath is pale grey, shimmery and highly reflective.  In spite of the sturdiness of the container, it remains light and airy.

items.name: a resplendent sunfire lampas vest with Elven gold buttons down the front
items.tap: a resplendent sunfire lampas vest with Elven gold buttons down the front
items.description: Richly patterned in solar designs, the satin background weave is over-woven with metallic threads as well as the brilliant yellow and orange sunfire fibers to create an opulent textile that is both lustrous and extravagant.  The creation process for the sunfire fibers gives the lavish fabric the illusion of sunlight dancing across its surface, with the multiple layers of the textile combining to form a luxuriant fabric that is both lustrous and ostentatious.

items.name: a rough-edged book with a battered khor'vela cover and a wraparound string
items.tap: a rough-edged book with a battered khor'vela cover and a wraparound string
items.description: Containing bits of undigested bone, the wooden cover of the book is worn and deeply gouged, with large chunks missing at the edges.  A simple string still functions enough to wrap around the book several times before tying it closed, while a sturdy steel chain affixed to the spine allows the book to be worn.

items.name: a round green bota in the shape of a turtle with water opal eyes
a ruined silversteel book entitled "The Book of Chadatru" with a defaced cover
a sable leather rucksack disguised as an amber-eyed owl with nightsilk feathers
a scalene duffle bag adorned with peacock jasper buttons
items.tap: a scalene duffle bag adorned with peacock jasper buttons
items.description: Made of smooth fabric with a subtly ridged appearance, the pack is dyed a light green hue.  Teardrop-shaped buttons secure the flap, protecting the wearer's belongings inside.  A luminescent inclusion similar to that of a peacock feather's eye is surrounded by an opalescent ring that radiates threadlike hues of bright green and gold.  A matching metal frame lends structure and shape to the rectangular container.

items.name: a scorched book entitled "Truffenyi's Children" bound with ox-hair
a shredded book of "The Triquetra" tethered to a frayed cord
items.tap: a shredded book of "The Triquetra" tethered to a frayed cord
items.description: Both the ironwood cover and the pages within bear four deep claw marks, in addition to numerous other long scratches and tears.  The failing leather cord loops through the spine and allows the book to be worn.

items.name: a silver chainmail belt interwoven with cambrinth animals
a silver dip pen capped with a stylized jade dragon
items.tap: a silver dip pen capped with a stylized jade dragon
items.description: The tail of the dragon wraps around and down the writing instrument's hollow tube.

items.name: a small Human doll
items.description: You see nothing special.

items.tap: a snarling lion cloak with some carved anli fake fangs

Amber-colored glass eyes stare out from the top of the cloak's deep hood, the lion's maw displaying its ferocious yellow wood carved fangs. | An inconspicuous tag reads, "Limited Tre" but is smudged and indecipherable beyond that.

items.name: a stately madun greatcloak mantled with thick jaguar fur
items.tap: a stately madun greatcloak mantled with thick jaguar fur
items.description: The golden fur stands out in stark contrast to the navy fabric composing the majority of this massive cloak.

items.name: a suit of umbral black tursa armor whorled with merging shadowy lines
a sungold sunburst with fiery rays of crimson glaes
items.tap: a sungold sunburst with fiery rays of crimson glaes
items.description: Naturally warm, the iridescent gold metal shimmers like a sunrise in progress, from the soft purple that shows with first light to the pale rose that lingers briefly after the sun has fully risen.  Subtly inlaid in yellow gold -- and therefore only discernible by carefully scrutinizing how light plays across the piece -- is a circle bounded by a square, bounded by an equilateral triangle, all of which are bounded by another circle.  A matching chain tethers the sunburst to the belt.

items.name: a thunder of pewter dragons displaying multihued wings
a triple-strand red gold hip-chain set with carved scarlet jade

-=   Instructions for crafting a cloth lootpouch    =-
A cloth lootpouch is a craftable item in the Outfitting society under the Tailoring crafting discipline.  This is considered to be a challenging piece to make, though knowledge of the Cloth Container Design technique will be beneficial to the crafter.
This item is listed as a "finished cloth container" ingredient type and is created using a yardstick, scissors, a needle and thinner thread.  A crafter may also find it helpful to have straight pins and a slickstone or flat iron on hand.
A list of ingredients is provided:
(1) finished fabric cloth (5 yards)

A serrated khopesh is a craftable item in the Forging society under the Weaponsmithing crafting discipline.  This is considered to be an intricate piece to make, though knowledge of the Basic Bladed Weapon Design technique will be beneficial to the crafter.
This item is listed as a "finished small metal bladed weapon" ingredient type and is created using a forging hammer, some tongs, some metalworking oil, a grindstone and a metal anvil with forge.  A crafter may also find it helpful to have a shovel and a bellows on hand.
A list of ingredients is provided:
(1) refined metal ingot (7 volume)
(1) finished wooden hilt
